definitions.explanation: The movement of water, air, or other fluids. Can refer to rivers, streams, or any continuous movement.
The direction or progression of events, time, or abstract concepts.

examples.japanese: {川|かわ}の{流|なが}れが{速|はや}い。
{時代|じだい}の{流|なが}れに{乗|の}る。
examples.english: To ride the tide of the times.

examples.japanese: {会話|かいわ}の{流|なが}れを{止|と}めないでください。
examples.english: Please don't interrupt the flow of conversation.

notes:
USAGE: {流|なが}れ is the noun form of {流|なが}れる (to flow). It's used both literally (water, air) and figuratively (events, time, trends).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{川|かわ}の{流|なが}れ (river current)
・{時|とき}の{流|なが}れ (passage of time)
・{流|なが}れに{逆|さか}らう (to go against the flow)
・{流|なが}れに{身|み}を{任|まか}せる (to go with the flow)
・{流|なが}れ{作業|さぎょう} (assembly line work)

COMPOUNDS:
・{流|なが}れ{星|ぼし} (shooting star)
・{流|なが}れ{者|もの} (drifter, wanderer)
・{血|ち}の{流|なが}れ (bloodline, lineage)
